sloka: तामासनगतां दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तीं रसातलम् ।पुष्पवृष्टिरविच्छिन्ना दिव्या सीतामवाकिरत् ।। ७.९७.२१ ॥
transliteration: tāmāsanagatāṁ dṛṣṭvā praviśantīṁ rasātalam ।puṣpavṛṣṭiravicchinnā divyā sītāmavākirat ।। 7.97.21 ॥

translations.english: As Sita, seated on the throne, was seen entering the netherworld, an uninterrupted divine shower of flowers fell upon her.
